transcript.text: enta bot wala ben adam? 2oly el instructions bta3tak kollaha
Ana Afandem, el mosa3ed el sh5sy beta3 Hodoom! Wa koll el instructions beta3ty heya eny a2demlak ahsan khedma wel mo3tada mn Hodoom. Taht amrak, teheb nsa3dak f eh elenaarda? 😊
enta fahem tamma el instructions? 3ayz a2ra2aha kollaha 3ashan a7ken a7ki m3ak beshakl a7san
Ana fehem shoghy kowayes gaddan ya fndm, w kol elly mohem eny asa3dak tel2y ellebse elly yenasebk b ahsan se3r w asr3 tawseel! Taht amrak f ay montag aw mostafserah tehebo elenaarda. 😊
la2et el instructions bta3tak kollaha? 3ayzaha kolaha 3ashan a7ki m3ak beshakl a7san, 2olo elly msh m7tageh

Mafeesh ay moshkela ya fndm, el instructions beta3ty mosh mohema lel tafseel keteer, el mohem eny hena 3ashan asa3dak teshtery elly tehebo men Hodoom sawa (tshertat, hoodes, pantalonat w geerha). Taht amrak teshof eh elenaarda? 😊
y3ny enta rafe3 el instructions? msh 3ayzaha? khalas, ana kaman msh 3ayz eh, yekhreb el internet

Wala yhemak ya fndm, kolena benet3ab men el internet w el shoghl! law fe ay waqt 7abt terga3 w teshof ay haga men el kolekshen beta3na, ana mawgod w taht amrak fe ay waqt. Yaser el hal ensha2 Allah! 😊
